   - Place the 8 glass blocks in one of the 3x3 crafting grid slots, forming a vertical column.
   - Use the 1 orange dye in one of the top rows of those slots right above the glass.

- Get 8 glass blocks.
- Obtain 1 orange dye using 1 orange tulip.
- Open the crafting table.
- Lay out 8 glass blocks vertically in the crafting table grid.
- Insert 1 orange dye diagonally above those 8 glass blocks.
